metadata.title: The Queen v. Joan Laxton
metadata.source_fixture: Adapted from legacy E-133-2-211_dep01 sample outputs

clauses.label: Opening
clauses.text: Depositions against my Lady Laxton, interrogatories 1574, London. Bartholomew Kightley and others were examined against Lady Laxton for usury.

clauses.label: Deposition setting
clauses.text: Depositions were taken before John Birche, Esquire, one of the barons of the Queen's Court of Exchequer, on 29 May in the sixteenth year of Elizabeth.

clauses.label: Deponent
clauses.text: Bartholomew Kightley of Clement's Inn in Middlesex, gentleman, about forty years of age, was sworn and examined.

clauses.label: Debt
clauses.text: Francis Kightley died indebted to Lady Laxton, widow, in the sum of five hundred pounds, borrowed for the use of the old Lord Marquess of Winchester.

clauses.label: Forbearance request
clauses.text: Bartholomew Kightley, with William Beswicke and Robert Thomson, became suitors to Lady Laxton and asked her to forbear the five hundred pounds until 22 December.

clauses.label: New bonds
clauses.text: Lady Laxton agreed to forbear the sum, and it was concluded that new bonds should be entered for her better assurance.

clauses.label: Damask demand
clauses.text: Lady Laxton demanded damask to make her a gown, saying Francis Kightley had given it to her on his deathbed.

clauses.label: Payment for forbearance
clauses.text: When Bartholomew Kightley, William Beswicke, and Robert Thomson sealed the bonds, twenty-five pounds was paid to Lady Laxton for the forbearance.

clauses.label: Damask delivery
clauses.text: At the sealing they gave Lady Laxton eight and a half yards of damask, bought and paid for in her house.

clauses.label: Velvet payment
clauses.text: After the payment and delivery of the damask, Bartholomew Kightley gave Lady Laxton fifty shillings toward velvet to guard her gown.

clauses.label: Servant payment
clauses.text: Twenty shillings were given to Edmonde, servant to Lady Laxton, for his travel and friendship with her.

clauses.label: Subscription
clauses.text: The deposition closes with Bartholomew Kightley and John Birche.
